item.title: Handovha: A Verifiable Handover, Without Accounts
item.author: Tonderai Khatai
item.description: Memory is not a receipt. A landlord and a tenant walk through a flat together, agree it’s fine, and shake hands. Six months later one of them remembers a scuff on the wall being there already; the other doesn’t. A fleet manager hands a van to a driver with a full tank and no dents; a week later, someone disagrees about which of those was true at handover. None of this is fraud, usually — it’s just that nobody wrote anything down at the one moment it mattered.
